requirements_payload.trigger_description: Before a Request record's status is changed to Submitted (via the 'Submit Request' toolbar rule), validate that all required fields have been filled; block the transition and surface the missing fields if not.
acceptance_criteria: Logged-in requesters can initiate creation of a new Core Service request from the Dashboard (or Requests area).
Requests can be created and submitted with samples, with the ability to add samples by creating new samples and/or attaching existing samples.
Requester should be able to add attachment (an optional feature) with the request if they require it.
Requesters can save drafts of the requests and can revisit & review later before finally submitting them.
Submission is blocked when required fields are missing, and the system identifies the missing required fields clearly.
If all the required information and fields are filled, requester can review it before making the final submission.

input_fields.name: C_RequestType
input_fields.validation: must be set (e.g. CVT) to determine extension datatype routing

input_fields.name: Status
input_fields.validation: must be 'In Draft' on create; gate the transition to 'Submitted'

input_fields.name: NumberOfSamples
input_fields.validation: unvalidated in ticket text; carry forward, confirm with Data Dictionary

input_fields.name: SampleRegistrationLink
input_fields.validation: populated when samples are attached/created via the request

business_rules: Requesters can save drafts before final submission — do not force full validation on every save, only on the Submit action.

'Submit Request' toolbar rule (Request form layout) validates all required fields are filled before allowing the status change to 'Submitted'; on failure it must clearly identify which required fields are missing.

SECONDARY BEHAVIOR (separate from the pre-save validation above, likely a distinct post-save/creation rule, not to be dropped in design/scaffold): when a Request is added via the layout's 'Add+' button with Request Type = CVT, a rule must auto-create a linked 'CVT Request' extension record and default the Request status to 'In Draft'.
'Add+' must also be enabled on the Sample layout so samples can be created/attached inline from the Request view.
Optional file attachment support on the Request.
